conversation.send.conflict: ⚠️ Your message was not sent — this conversation is busy or waiting on a decision. Try again in a moment.
conversation.send.awaiting: ⚠️ Your message was not sent — this conversation is waiting on a decision.
conversation.send.notFound: ⚠️ Your message was not sent — this agent is not ready to answer (it may not be deployed). It is back in the message box.
conversation.send.tooLarge: ⚠️ Your message was not sent — it or its attachment is too large. It is back in the message box.
conversation.send.rateLimited: ⚠️ Your message was not sent — you have reached a usage limit. Wait a moment and try again.
conversation.send.unavailable: ⚠️ Your message was not sent — the service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
conversation.send.ended: ⚠️ This conversation has ended. Start a new conversation to continue.

conversation.send.failed: ⚠️ Your message could not be sent. It is back in the message box — please try again.
conversation.send.connectionLost: Connection lost — the response may be incomplete.

conversation.stop.finished: Stop came too late: the reply had already finished on the server, and it counts. Here it is in full.
conversation.stop.stillRunning: Stop did not reach this turn: it is still running on another server, and what it does still counts. Its reply appears when you reopen the conversation.
conversation.stop.unreachable: Stop could not reach the server. The turn may still be running there; reopen the conversation to see how it ended.
